name: Acropolis of Athens
desc: The OG skyline flex, 2,400 years running. Go at dawn, beat the heat, and pretend the Parthenon was built just for your someday montage.

name: Acropolis Museum
desc: Glass floors over ancient streets and marbles staring right back at you. Cheaper than therapy, older than everything you own.

name: Monastiraki Flea Market
desc: Sunday chaos of vinyl, brass lamps and maybe-real antiques under the Acropolis. Haggling is free and the people-watching is priceless.

name: Lycabettus Hill
desc: Huff up the pine path at sunset and watch Athens glow orange all the way to the sea. Costs zero, feels like a movie ending.

name: Temple of Olympian Zeus
desc: A handful of colossal columns that took 600 years to finish. Proof your side project timeline is fine, honestly.

name: Panathenaic Stadium
desc: All-marble stadium where the first modern Olympics ran. Sprint the track, climb the podium, collect your imaginary gold.

name: National Garden
desc: Shady escape hatch behind Parliament — palms, turtles, free-roaming ducks. The cheapest reset button in the city.

name: Ancient Agora
desc: Where Socrates cornered strangers with questions. Wander the old marketplace and get philosophical for pocket change.

name: Anafiotika
desc: A tiny island village smuggled onto the Acropolis slope. Whitewashed lanes, sleepy cats, zero entry fee, maximum daydream.
